"山哥在干嘛呢？"

二壮望着拉满弓的李青山，一脸憨厚道：“这么久了，挺累的吧？”

“嘘嘘……小点声，不要影响山哥，老老实实待着！”

大壮朝着身后二壮瞪了一眼，一行四人便在原地不动弹，大壮心中揣着疑惑，完全不知道李青山在干嘛。

这个距离，按照山哥的手艺来说。

应当百发百中的才是。

狩猎的时候，很多人将距离给模糊化了，完全不知道十米，二十米，三十米之间是什么概念，甚至还有人吹牛逼说百米之外，一箭射中野兔子的话。

正常情况下，10米到20米的野兔子，能够很清晰看到野兔子的眼睛，身上的花纹，一举一动都能够看的清楚，甚至包括与这只野兔子接下来的动作，这个距离狩猎极其容易。

这个时候，你举起自己的拳头，这十米内的野兔子，在视线中就跟你的拳头大小。

20米到40的话，还能看清楚野兔子的轮廓，这个时候你从口袋里掏出一枚鸡蛋，在你得视线中，这野兔子就跟你手中的鸡蛋差不多大小，这个距离一般人射杀都没问题。

当然了，二十米的时候鸡蛋就大一些，四十米的时候鸡蛋换成鹌鹑蛋吧！

40米到60米的时候，伸出你经常伺候自己的右手，看一眼你得指甲盖子，野兔子就这么大了，这个距离你跟我说想猎杀？

别闹了

这还是能见度情况不错的情况下，要是天气太热，地面上会出现一些热浪，或者刮风，那就更不能怎么看得清了。

百米之外！！

那基本就是属于开玩笑了，当然看是能看到的，但是想要用猎弓射杀，痴心妄想。

四十米，就是普通猎人的极限。

六十米之内，甚至五十米之内，就是经验老道猎人的极限。

有些经验老道的猎人因为长时间在户外，并且训练视力，会比刚入行不久的普通猎人的视力好上许多，五十米之内是有机会射杀的，有些视力好，有经验的猎人，能够射杀六十米之内的野兔子。

这些野兔子不是固定靶，是移动的，趴在草丛中的时候，身体会比你抓到的时候更小一些，因为有一部分身体被草遮掩，还有这几十米的距离，不可能什么杂物都没有。

李青山因为养生拳的原因，视力比经验老道的猎人都要好上许多，而且随着不断打养生拳，体内纯阳真气不断滋养，视力也越来越好。

要是有一把56式单兵之王枪在手的话！

那真的能杀穿整个老林子，可惜现在自己手中只有一把单管猎枪，精准度远远不如，威力也不行，当然比自己手中这把猎弓的威力大。

防范黑瞎子，野狼则是很好用。

"What is Brother Shan doing?"

Er Zhuang looked at Li Qingshan, who had his bow fully drawn, and said with a simple and honest face: "It's been so long, you're quite tired, right?"

"Shhhhhh... keep your voice down, don't disturb Brother Shan, just stay calm!"

Da Zhuang glared at the two Zhuangs behind him, and the four of them stood still on the spot. Da Zhuang was filled with doubts and had no idea what Li Qingshan was doing.

This distance is based on Brother Shan's skills.

He should be the one who always hits the mark.

When hunting, many people blur the distance and have no idea what ten meters, twenty meters, and thirty meters are. Some people even brag about hitting a wild rabbit with an arrow from a hundred meters away.

Under normal circumstances, a wild rabbit at 10 to 20 meters can clearly see its eyes, patterns on its body, and every move, including the next movements of the wild rabbit. Hunting at this distance is extremely easy.

At this time, you raise your fist, and the wild rabbit within ten meters is the size of your fist.

If you are 20 to 40 meters away, you can still clearly see the outline of a hare. At this time, you take out an egg from your pocket. In your sight, the hare is about the same size as the egg in your hand. Most people can shoot it from this distance.

Of course, when you reach 20 meters, the eggs will be bigger. When you reach 40 meters, the eggs should be replaced with quail eggs!

When you are 40 meters to 60 meters, stretch out your right hand that you always serve yourself and take a look at your fingernail cover. The wild rabbit is so big. At this distance, you told me that you want to hunt?

Stop making trouble

This is when the visibility is good. If the weather is too hot, there will be some heat waves on the ground, or it is windy, it will be hard to see clearly.

A hundred meters away!!

That was basically a joke. Of course you could see it, but wanting to kill it with a hunting bow was just wishful thinking.

Forty meters is the limit for ordinary hunters.

Within sixty meters, or even within fifty meters, is the limit of experienced hunters.

Some experienced hunters, because they have been outdoors for a long time and have trained their eyesight, have much better eyesight than ordinary hunters who have just entered the industry. They can shoot within fifty meters. Some experienced hunters with good eyesight can shoot wild rabbits within sixty meters.

These wild rabbits are not fixed targets, they are mobile. When lying in the grass, their bodies will be smaller than when you caught them, because part of their bodies are covered by the grass, and there are still dozens of meters away, so it is impossible for them to be free of debris.

Because of the health-preserving boxing, Li Qingshan's eyesight is much better than that of experienced hunters. As he continues to practice health-preserving boxing, the pure yang energy in his body is constantly nourished, and his eyesight is getting better and better.

If only you had a Type 56 Individual King Gun in hand!

That can really kill through the entire old forest. Unfortunately, I only have a single-barreled shotgun in my hand now, which is far less accurate and less powerful. It is certainly more powerful than the hunting bow in my hand.

To guard against black blind men and wild wolves, it is very useful.
